There have been times when music felt entirely my own. It has always been something deeply personal to me. I could simply listen to it, immerse myself in my own emotions, recall certain moments of my life, and find rest in it.

Today, however, perhaps because of a sudden wave of anxiety and an unexplained sense of inferiority, this music felt strangely distant. I found myself thinking that it was nothing more than the emotional expression of artists who seem to live in a completely different world from mine—people who appear self-assured, closed off, and even self-centered. I felt as though I had nothing to do with their music.

And yet, you reminded me once again of something remarkable: the miracle that music can still bring us together and allow us to feel a sense of shared humanity.
